acceptance: safe_division defaults off; with it on, output matches the BenchBox helpers for BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks and ClickHouse; the semantic change (zero divisor returns NULL) is documented in the fork README.
Alias dedupe preserves the existing skip rules (SELECT *, ORDER/GROUP references) and handles nested selects, with tests.
Real-engine proof: Databricks TRY_DIVIDE and alias behavior run on local PySpark; BigQuery and Snowflake get AST tests and the gap is recorded.
Fork make check, make benchbox-dist and make benchbox-check pass; PR merged.
description: Add the fork's rewrite API (sqlglot/benchbox/ package is created by F1). Move the adapter-side AST rewrites: BigQuery SAFE_DIVIDE, Snowflake NULLIF divisor, Databricks TRY_DIVIDE and ClickHouse decimal division behind one opt-in safe_division option (off by default); Databricks duplicate-output-alias suffixing; a function returning unqualified Table nodes (BigQuery dataset state stays in the adapter); the TPC-DI flag-column fold taking the column list as an argument; Databricks PRIMARY KEY NULLS FIRST/LAST removal as generator behavior. These run at execution time on already-translated SQL, so BenchBox reaches them through apply_rewrite added in the first adoption.
